hardConstraintNote: Must not introduce new characters or locations; must be integrated seamlessly into existing descriptions of the Weaver and her abilities.
rationale: The narrative lacks a clear explanation for the Weaver’s ability to manipulate reality through song. This ambiguity weakens the sense of consequence and wonder surrounding her actions. Introducing a subtle origin story—perhaps linking her power to an ancient, forgotten pact or a resonance with the world's foundational music—would deepen the mythos without disrupting the core narrative flow.
title: Clarify the Source of the Weaver's Power
